cohort: 39 women who presented with vesicovaginal fistula (VVF) at a tertiary care center in Jammu over a 5-year period
finding: The study found a 100% success rate for VVF repair, which the authors attributed to factors such as proper patient evaluation, appropriate surgical approach, and skilled surgical technique.
mod_finding: Difficult vaginal delivery was the most common cause of VVF (24 out of 39 patients).
